assertions.assertion: Program.cs calls AddServerSideSessions() on the IdentityServer builder chain
Program.cs configures AddOperationalStore with UseSqlServer using the connection string from configuration
assertions.rationale: AddOperationalStore configures ConfigureDbContext with db.UseSqlServer(connectionString), where connectionString comes from GetConnectionString("IdentityServer").

assertions.assertion: Program.cs does not rely on the default in-memory session store for production use
assertions.rationale: The in-memory default is explicitly replaced with the durable EF Core operational store on SQL Server, and the response calls this out.
